subject.title: feat(mattermost): read channel history with guarded permissions

question: Should OpenClaw permanently accept the action-scoped core authorization exception that delegates Mattermost `read` target authorization to the bundled plugin, alongside the new opt-in `actions.messages` contract?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but selecting the permanent owner boundary for delegated cross-channel reads and adding a public capability toggle are product and security-contract decisions rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the guarded contract
options.body: Approve the opt-in `actions.messages` setting and the Mattermost-`read`-only core exception, then land after current-head checks complete.

options.title: Require a generic core seam
options.body: Pause this PR and define a generic, documented provider-read authorization contract before adding another named core exception.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers do not want cross-channel Mattermost history reads in the bundled plugin.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded contract
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in `actions.messages` setting and the Mattermost-`read`-only core exception, then land after current-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed authorization and configuration design and can provide the implementation context, while the final contract choice remains a repository-owner decision.
